decisions.reason: As a design-focused extension very close to the firm’s core drainage know-how and still actively promoted in 2024, this range fits existing capabilities and can be refined cheaply through the firm’s own development and market feedback.

This shower channel is tightly related to the firm’s established drainage systems and the continuing standalone presentation suggests the firm can use its technical support, planner links, and in-house R&D to improve and sustain it.

Although the earlier pump-assisted line was withdrawn quickly, this 2024 launch likely reflects learning from that experience and remains close enough to the firm’s drainage competence that management would usually give it more time before dropping it.
